text: Harness: per-cycle trace store for replay and evaluation
description: Persist per cycle: harness config version, compiled context per stage, model outputs, tool calls, diff, verdict, usage. Stored under .bowman/runtime/traces (gitignored, size-bounded). Enables replaying a stage with another model or config, offline A/B comparison, and the memory-usefulness measurement (did a reflection in context change the decision?).
